care.title: Take care of your wig
care.intro: A few simple steps to keep your wig beautiful for longer.

beforeWearing.title: Before wearing
beforeWearing.text: Gently prepare the fibers with your fingers and adjust the cap without pulling on the lace.

washing.title: Washing
washing.text: Use lukewarm water and gentle products. Don't rub: let it soak, then rinse delicately.

drying.title: Drying
drying.text: Pat dry with a clean towel and let it air-dry on a suitable stand.

styling.title: Styling
styling.text: Detangle from the ends to the roots. Keep heat moderate and suited to the fiber.

storage.title: Storage
storage.text: Store your wig clean, dry and out of the sun, ideally on a stand.

delivery.title: Delivery and returns
delivery.intro: We're with you before, during and after your order.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.text: Request within 24 h. The wig must be new, unworn and unaltered, with intact lace and all its accessories.
